title: Hero Heel
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Minami, a young actor, takes the lead in a children's superhero TV show half-heartedly until he is impressed by the talent of his co-star Sawada. After seeing Sawada kiss a man, Minami struggles with his own growing attraction, and a love triangle develops on set. A three-volume adult boys' love drama in the TV industry.
life_message: Love and professional dedication both demand facing one's true feelings, even through hurt.
